TICKET_SUBJECT_REQUIRED.title: Subject is required
TICKET_SUBJECT_REQUIRED.detail: The ticket subject cannot be empty.

TICKET_SUBJECT_TOO_LONG.title: Subject is too long
TICKET_SUBJECT_TOO_LONG.detail: The ticket subject must have at most {max} characters.

TICKET_BODY_REQUIRED.title: Description is required
TICKET_BODY_REQUIRED.detail: The ticket description cannot be empty.

TICKET_BODY_TOO_LONG.title: Description is too long
TICKET_BODY_TOO_LONG.detail: The ticket description must have at most {max} characters.

TRIAGE_VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Triage was changed by someone else
TRIAGE_VERSION_CONFLICT.detail: You sent version {expected}, but the triage has changed. Reload it and try again.

TRIAGE_REFUSED_BY_MODEL.title: Ticket could not be triaged automatically
TRIAGE_REFUSED_BY_MODEL.detail: The model declined to classify this ticket. Route it manually.

VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Invalid request
VALIDATION_FAILED.detail: One or more fields are invalid. See the errors list.

UNAUTHORIZED.title: Authentication required
UNAUTHORIZED.detail: Send a valid API key in the X-API-Key header.

RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.title: Resource not found
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.detail: The requested URL does not exist.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Triage service temporarily unavailable
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: The language model is unavailable. Try again in a few seconds.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Unexpected error
INTERNAL_ERROR.detail: Something went wrong. Report the correlation id to support.
